name: How to Set Up robots.txt for LLM Crawlers
description: A step-by-step guide to configuring your robots.txt file to manage access from AI training and retrieval bots.

step.name: Identify Active LLM Bots
step.text: Review your server logs to identify which LLM bots are currently crawling your site.

step.name: Categorize by Purpose
step.text: Separate the bots into training bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Bytespider) and real-time retrieval bots (ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, OAI-SearchBot).

step.name: Configure Access Rules
step.text: Add User-agent directives and Allow/Disallow rules for each bot category based on your chosen access strategy.

step.name: Test and Validate
step.text: Use Google's Rich Results Test or Schema.org's validator to confirm your markup parses correctly, then monitor server logs for compliance.
